seo.title: Postgraduate Computer Engineering in Australia | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Study Master's in Computer Engineering in Australia for Indian students. Learn about top universities (UNSW, Melbourne, Monash, Queensland), eligibility, fees, Engineers Australia accreditation, and career opportunities.

overview: Australian universities deliver globally recognized postgraduate computer engineering education accredited by Engineers Australia under the Washington Accord. Students gain advanced design skills, research expertise, and international employment opportunities.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to pursue graduate studies in computer engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes, subject to the university's admission requirements, qualified Indian students may apply for postgraduate engineering programs in computer engineering or related fields.

faq.question: How long does a postgraduate degree in computer engineering take?
faq.answer: Depending on the requirements and prior academic experience, many programs last between one and two years.

faq.question: What kind of bachelor's degree is necessary?
faq.answer: It can be necessary to have a degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, electronics, or another recognized field. Program-specific requirements differ.

faq.question: Is taking the IELTS required?
faq.answer: Proof of English competence is required by several universities. The institution determines which tests are accepted and under what circumstances.

faq.question: Can I get a degree in artificial intelligence or cybersecurity?
faq.answer: Relevant courses or specializations are offered by certain postgraduate programs. The precise curriculum and accessible electives should be confirmed with the students.
